title: Small-set center of mass
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $\alpha\in\mathbb R$, define a vector in $\mathbb R^n$ whose $i$th coordinate is $\mathbb E_x[f(x)x_i]/\alpha$, where $x$ is uniformly distributed on the Boolean cube.
